Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR Analysis Note v5.0.5, section 3 and event_selection_table.tex. Kinematic plots are existing loose-preselection examples, not regenerated with the updated eight-hit requirement. Eight-hit counting convention follows the meeting instruction and is not assigned a 2D/3D definition here.
Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR Analysis Note v5.0.5, section 2. Search/support [MeV]: 2015 19–100/14–135; 2016 39–180/30–210; 2021 native 10% 50–250/36–300. Pinned archived spectra.
Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR Analysis Note v5.0.5, section 2. Search/support [MeV]: 2015 19–100/14–135; 2016 39–180/30–210; 2021 native 10% 50–250/36–300. Pinned archived spectra.

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR Analysis Note v5.0.5, section 4. x=log(m); C is covariance amplitude, ell is correlation length, alpha approximately1/y is log-count observation noise. Curves are analytic illustrations; the noise-response weight is the exact one-point expression C/(C+alpha).

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR Analysis Note v5.0.5, v5_extraction_2021_peaks.pdf, 78 MeV panel. Native 2021 10% data. Gold dotted GP mean; blue dashed profiled background; red total; purple dotted signal. Blue band: GP constraint.

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR v5.0.5 archived spectrum_2021.npz and fixed const/ls states. Predictions replayed without optimization at60,120,220MeV, with +-2.25 sigma masks. Residuals use marginal variances; Q uses full covariance. Q/Nbin is not a calibrated chi-square/dof.

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR v5.0.5 archived spectrum_2021.npz. Q=(n-b)^T [diag(b)+C_GP]^-1(n-b), evaluated with archived fixed GP kernel states over201 masses 50–250MeV. Nbin is the held-out bin count. Adjacent masks are correlated. No effective-dof, chi-square, KS probability or coverage calibration is established.

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR v5.0.5, methodology matched-reference diagnostics. Pull=(fitted signed yield-injected yield)/(post-injection fit uncertainty). Reference error that sets injected yield is distinct from this denominator. Mean0 and width1 are conditional targets, not limit coverage.

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR v5.0.5,05_toys_validation.tex, table v491-sixtyfive-results. At65MeV,100 backgrounds:1%times10 baseline/refined mean pulls0.789/0.139, GP support40–300MeV; native10% baseline/threshold+extended support0.716/-0.246, support30–300MeV.90% mean intervals. Shaded+-0.5 band is post-result practical tolerance. Production support36–300MeV is separate.

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR v5.0.5,04_methodology.tex, matched-reference injection. Ainj,t(z)=z sigma_A,ref,t for z=0,1,3,5. Template is bin integrated over full support. Four strengths share the same background realization. Refit sidebands and signed extraction. Illustration is not observed data.
Sources and interpretation: Cowan et al., Eur.Phys.J.C71(2011)1554, https://arxiv.org/abs/1007.1727 . One-sided bounded discovery statistic; local asymptotic interpretation.

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR v5.0.5,04_methodology.tex. Pointwise bounded asymptotic CLs limit at0.1; no discovery mass-scan penalty applied. Plot is an illustrative Gaussian-Wald zero-best-fit case CLs=2[1-Phi(A/sigma)], crossing1.645sigma; not an observed HPS profile. Yield A90 converts to epsilon squared with dataset normalization.

Sources and interpretation: HPS-GPR v5.0.5,v505_projections.tex and derived/v505_projection_ten_table.tex. Conditional single-region persistence:10%-derived continuum scaled to full exposure, GP-Asimov signal target matched to sqrt(10) times local Z;20Poisson toys, full moving-window refit. No full2021 observed spectrum opened. R compares injected/continuum A90; D=1-R at neighboring echo. Target matching is imposed, not a calibrated forecast.

Sources and interpretation: Ananiev and Read, JINST18(2023)P05041, https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.12328 . HPS-specific response from v5.8.5.3, inputs/fields/2021.npz. Sigma_r=D^T D; displayed K is normalized correlationR, not raw covariance. Fixed observed-data-derived source,0.5MeV grid,+-2.25sigma. First five saved Poisson-refit scans. The second GP models scan response, while the background GP models counts.

Sources and interpretation: Ananiev and Read, JINST18(2023)P05041, https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.12328 . HPS v5.8.5.3 raw_significance.tex and raw_global_table.tex.2021 native10%,50–250MeV,0.5MeV grid,+-2.25sigma. Raw local peak78MeV Z2.808645,p0.002487524.200000saved Gaussian fields give global raw-maximum p0.25092. Full-refit check57/256;95% interval0.1732–0.2786. Frozen observed-data-derived source; conditional calibration. No observed-root centering/rescaling. Earlier reference-local ordering is a different statistic, not the look-elsewhere correction.
